title: Programiz: Harshad Number Checker
description: An integer is a Harshad (or Niven) number if it is divisible by the sum of its digits (e.g. 18 -> 1 + 8 = 9; 18 is divisible by 9). Given integer `n`, return `True` if it is a Harshad number, else `False`.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^9
• Time: O(log N) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Calculates sum of digits and verifies n % sum == 0 in O(log N) time.
